prompt: A monumental classic rubber duck silhouette as a centred editorial showpiece, scaled large within the frame and shot from a low cinematic angle, the duck's head reaching toward the upper third of the composition. The duck has a bright mint green porcelain-matte finish, a soft hand-shaped beak, and a plain oval pupil with no decorative glint. It stands on a seamless paper-toned backdrop in #F2F2F0 warm off-white, NOT yellow, NOT tinted beyond palette. Lighting is editorial: a large soft north-facing window light skims the left cheek, with a low fill card and a single subtle rim from camera right. The composition references a publication spread — generous negative space, oversized typography could sit alongside — with a faint halftone dot field ghosting into the lower right. Surface is matte porcelain, no gloss, no lacquer, no reflection. Footprint, beak, wingtip and head outline match the rest of the product line exactly. Mood is composed, architectural, restrained.
